Item map for Bookmark standard setting

Source: R/pipeline-cuts.R
item_map.Rd

Locates every item (and every score category of a polytomous item) on the ability scale at the response probability rp: the ability at which a test taker has probability rp of answering correctly (or of reaching that category or higher). Sorted by location, this is the ordered item booklet of the Bookmark method; a panelist's bookmark translates to a cut at the location of the bookmarked item.

Usage

item_map(p, rp = 0.67, form = NULL)

Arguments

p

a calibrated pipeline.

rp

response probability, commonly 0.67 (or 0.50).

form

optional fixed form number from assemble_forms().

Value

A tibble with one row per item category: page (position in the booklet), item, category, and theta, the location at rp. Items that never reach rp (a lower asymptote above it) have NA and come last.

Examples

# \donttest{
p <- calibrate(add_responses(mv_pipeline(), Science), model = "graded")
#> Warning: Calibration is running with 1 review open flag(s) from earlier stages:
#>   #1 [review] sparse_category: Comfort (category 1: n = 5)
#> Flags only warn because strict = FALSE. See flags(p).
item_map(p)
#> # A tibble: 12 × 4
#>     page item    category theta
#>    <int> <chr>      <int> <dbl>
#>  1     1 Comfort        1 -3.99
#>  2     2 Benefit        1 -2.41
#>  3     3 Future         1 -1.97
#>  4     4 Work           1 -1.81
#>  5     5 Comfort        2 NA   
#>  6     6 Comfort        3 NA   
#>  7     7 Work           2 NA   
#>  8     8 Work           3 NA   
#>  9     9 Future         2 NA   
#> 10    10 Future         3 NA   
#> 11    11 Benefit        2 NA   
#> 12    12 Benefit        3 NA   
# }
